test_title: PYST 51: SSC CPO - General Intelligence and Reasoning (Held on 03 Oct, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question: Six students are sitting around a circular table facing the centre. A is an immediate neighbour of both E and D. E sits third to the right of C. D sits third to the left of F. E is an immediate neighbour of F. B sits second to the left of E. Who sits to the immediate left of C?
solution:
**Given: **Six students are sitting around a circular table facing the centre.

E sits third to the right of C.

B sits second to the left of E.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/97aa35aa2d49ca23142e02a75ef4d48cfa6a71bcff192caa77b01dc261196f7d.png] 

E is an immediate neighbour of F.

A is an immediate neighbour of both E and D.

D sits third to the left of F.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4a56f1126f2d98d1c53dd476fbad9bba1d01f6bdcfd92c6665c5b73388a998fc.png] 

Here, D sits to the immediate left of C.

Hence, the correct answer is ***'Option 2'.***
